description.en: A deep unrolling network with cross-stage memory and spatial and frequency learning, evaluated on low-dose PET, undersampled MRI and sparse-view CT.
description.zh-CN: 结合跨阶段记忆、空间域学习和频域一致性的深度展开网络，在低剂量 PET、欠采样 MRI 和稀疏角度 CT 上进行了评估。

description.en: A self-supervised unfolding method for dual-camera compressive imaging that uses a panchromatic measurement to guide hyperspectral reconstruction.
description.zh-CN: 面向双相机压缩成像的自监督深度展开方法，利用全色测量引导高光谱图像重建。

description.en: A model-based unfolding method that combines low-rank tensor structure and spatial–spectral priors for snapshot hyperspectral reconstruction.
description.zh-CN: 结合低秩张量结构与空谱先验，用于快照压缩高光谱图像重建的模型驱动深度展开方法。
